verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no cheaper draft render mode and no way to upscale a chosen take to final quality. Storyboard review before generation (heygen-docs-12), scene-level revision (heygen-docs-11), and 4K export as a plan feature (heygen-docs-21) are adjacent capabilities. None of them is a low-cost draft that is later upscaled, so they earn no credit for this story.
